item.title: New Microsoft Gaming CEO: What Makes a Great Game, No Tolerance for Bad AI, Replacing Phil Spencer
item.description: It's the dawn of a new era for Xbox. New Microsoft Gaming CEO Asha Sharma discusses "great games," not tolerating "bad AI" and replacing Phil Spencer.

item.title: Patrick Soderlund named executive chairman of Nexon
item.description: The industry veteran has been tasked with leading the next phase of growth after overseeing the successful launch of Arc Raiders.

item.title: "I think the franchise is dead," says Saints Row design director
item.description: Original Saints Row design director Chris Stockman has declared the Saints Row franchise is "dead".

item.title: New Leadership Team Set to Shape the Next Era of Assassins Creed
item.description: Today, Vantage Studios, a Ubisoft subsidiary, announced the appointment of three seasoned leaders who will play a pivotal role in driving the Assassins Creed brands long-term vision.

item.title: Nacon Connect 2026 set for March 4
item.description: Nacon will host Nacon Connect 2026 on March 4 at 11:00 a.m. PT / 2:00 p.m. ET, the company announced. You will be able to watch it on YouTube and Twitch.

item.title: Nintendo Treehouse: Live set for February 24
item.description: Nintendo will host a Nintendo Treehouse: Live broadcast on February 24 at 2:00 p.m. PT / 5:00 p.m. ET featuring hands-on gameplay of Super Mario Bros. Wonder Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Meetup in Bellabel Park and Pokemon Pokopia, the company announced. You will be able to watch them on YouTube. It will run for roughly 80 minutes.

item.title: WWE 2K26 Hands-On Preview | The Outerhaven
item.description: The Outerhaven was invited by 2K to attend a hands-on event for their upcoming wrestling game WWE 2K26. What we got to play left me impressed and chomping at the bit to play more.

item.title: Demon Tides Review - Oceans of Fun | COGconnected
item.description: Demon Tides is a fascinating mix of open-world exploration and high-speed 3D platforming in a cute, clumsy package.

item.title: Styx: Blades of Greed Review - Stealth Shines, Performance Falters | COGconnected
item.description: Styx: Blades of Greed is the third game about a profanity-loving, sneaky thief and goblin with a love for a magic crystal called Quartz.

item.title: D1AL-ogue Review - Love, Death, and Robot Girls | COGconnected
item.description: D1AL-ogue is a fun, sexy, and sometimes philosophical exploration of the pain of building relationships under cyberpunk capitalism.
